# Mehrdad Hedayati

> Engineering Team Lead at Roadsurfer, based in Frankfurt, Germany. Leads the AI & Automation team (4 engineers, since 10/2025) and the Platform Engineering team (2 engineers, since 08/2026). Writes code for most of the week. Works with Claude Code every day and shares agentic coding practices with other engineers at Roadsurfer.

## Selected work

- Roadsurfer automation platform on n8n: concept to production in under 3 months; 20+ business workflows and 100+ tools used by all departments; rollout from days to minutes; zero production regressions since the automated testing solution launched.
- Roadsurfer MarTech: sole engineer on the Segment to Braze event pipeline, 2M+ events a day, no downtime in 6+ months; migrated 12B+ customer data points from a legacy CDP to Braze for 800K+ monthly active users.
- Interaction Design Foundation: a 5-month investigation cut wasted ad spend from $300K to under $70K a month; email deliverability from 71% to 96%.
- Podro: founding engineer and interim CTO; engineering grew from 5 to 30+.
